subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should ordered `agent:bootstrap` hook handlers remain one uninterrupted shared-context mutation chain, or may unrelated event-loop work interleave between handlers?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but choosing atomic bootstrap mutation versus cooperative interleaving changes the runtime contract and cannot be inferred from existing documentation or ordering tests.

options.title: Retain atomic dispatch
options.body: Remove only the inter-handler yield while preserving asynchronous reads, cooperative glob traversal, diagnostics, and regression coverage.

options.title: Approve cooperative interleaving
options.body: Keep the yield and explicitly document and test reentrancy and shared bootstrap-event mutation behavior.

recommendation.title: Retain atomic dispatch
recommendation.body: Remove only the inter-handler yield while preserving asynchronous reads, cooperative glob traversal, diagnostics, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently authored the exact bootstrap dispatch boundary on current main.
